exposure: Physical activity level in late pregnancy
Lifestyle intervention including group exercise classes
Physical activity level in late pregnancy (quartile 1 vs. quartile 4)
outcome: Length of first stage of labor
Length of second stage of labor
cohort: 303 healthy nulliparous women with singleton pregnancy in the intervention group and 303 in the control group
finding: A lifestyle intervention including group exercise classes was associated with a longer first stage of labor but not with other labor outcomes.
mod_finding: A high physical activity level in late pregnancy was associated with lower odds of acute cesarean delivery compared with a low physical activity level.
